'''Tal Teklan''' is a location in [[Varlamore]], within the [[Tlati Rainforest]]. It was the first major settlement of the [[Talkasti]] people.{{CiteNPC|npc=Curator Herminius|quote=While [the Talkasti] initially lived nomadic lives, they eventually started to establish more permanent settlements, with Tal Teklan being the first.}}

[[Scrambled!]] takes place in Tal Teklan.

==Transportation==
To get to this location, players can use:
* The [[Quetzal Transport System]]. The landing site does not have to be built.
* [[Achilka|Achilka's boat service]] from [[Kastori]]. (Travel to Kastori with the [[Pendant of Ates]] and then run a short distance south-east to Achilka.)

==Features==
* [[File:Bank icon.png|link=Tal Teklan bank]] [[Tal Teklan bank]]
* [[File:Archery shop icon.png|link=Arcuani's Archery Supplies]] [[Arcuani's Archery Supplies]] - run by [[Arcuani]]
* [[File:Dye trader icon.png|link=Dyes to Die For]] [[Dyes to Die For]] - run by [[Xochitl]]
* [[File:General store icon.png|link=Tal Teklan General Store]] [[Tal Teklan General Store]]
* [[File:Magic shop icon.png|link=Tal Teklan Rune Shop]] [[Tal Teklan Rune Shop]] - run by [[Teicuh]]
* [[File:Pub icon.png|link=The King's Inn]] [[The King's Inn]] - run by [[King (Tal Teklan)|King]]
* [[File:Altar icon.png|link=Tal Teklan temple]] A [[Tal Teklan temple|temple]] with an [[Altar (Varlamore)|altar]]
* [[File:Furnace icon.png|link=Furnace]] The blacksmith with a [[furnace]] and [[anvil]]
* [[File:Fishing spot icon.png]] Just north of the town are two [[Fishing spot (big net, harpoon)|big net/harpoon]] [[Fishing]] spots
* [[File:Water source icon.png]] A [[fountain]] just west of the bank
